meaning: Stage-level unit tests vs. end-to-end integration oracle benchmark across 5 model families (Theorem 76): Phase 1 shows that on (n_11, n_10, n_01, n_00) = (1, 1, 1, 1), factored stage kernel Z_2 * Z_1 = 2 equals global kernel Z_E = 2 (LPR = GPR = 1/2), masking NGD rate 1/4 and PGD rate 1/4 (EGD = 1/2, L_mask = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1); Phase 2 shows unmasked NGD regression on (1, 1, 0, 2) with R_E = -1 (L_ngd = 1, E_g = 0, Delta_E = -1); Phase 3 verifies 4-tuple contingency reconstruction (N, sum L, sum E_g, n_-) and boundary repair to (2, 0, 0, 2) with EGD = 0 (L_full = 1, E_g = 1, Delta_E = 0).
